name: mcp-google-analytics
description: GA4 MCP that reads AND writes: reports, funnels, audits, and server-side events. 26 tools.
long_description: The GA4 MCP that reads AND writes. Most GA4 MCP servers are read-only. This one gives your AI agent the full loop: run reports and funnels (Data API), audit your setup (custom dimensions, key events, compatibility checks), send ecommerce and conversion events server-side (Measurement Protocol v2), and verify them in the realtime report.

ga_service_account_json.title: Service Account JSON
ga_service_account_json.description: Path to the service account key file, or the JSON itself (enables the 16 read tools)

ga_property_id.title: GA4 Property ID
ga_property_id.description: Numeric property ID, e.g. 123456789 (enables the 16 read tools)

ga_measurement_id.title: Measurement ID
ga_measurement_id.description: Data stream measurement ID, e.g. G-XXXXXXXXXX (enables the 10 event-sending tools)

ga_api_secret.title: Measurement Protocol API Secret
ga_api_secret.description: API secret created under the data stream (enables the 10 event-sending tools)
